title: AlterLab Skill Eval File
description: Canonical schema for per-skill eval files at skills/<domain>/<skill>/evals/evals.json. One file per skill. Each eval is a realistic researcher ask plus the behavior we expect, encoded as machine-checkable assertions. Validated per-PR by scripts/run_evals.py --strict; behavioral grading (run_evals.py --behavioral) shells to the claude CLI and LLM-judges expected_output.

skill.description: The skill name this eval file targets. MUST match the skill's frontmatter `name` and its directory name (e.g. alterlab-deep-research).

evals.description: All eval cases for this skill. Convention: >=3 should_trigger cases and >=1 near-miss should_not_trigger case (an adjacent skill's territory).

id.description: Stable, unique-within-file identifier in kebab-case (e.g. full-research, near-miss-paper-writer).

prompt.description: The realistic researcher ask sent to the model, verbatim. Phrase it the way a faculty member or grad student would actually type it.

expected_output.description: Prose description of the correct behavior/output. Used as the rubric for the behavioral LLM judge. For near-miss negatives, describe the deferral (which adjacent skill should handle it and why this one should not).

files.description: Optional input fixtures the eval supplies to the model (paths relative to the skill's evals/ dir, or inline content). Use when the ask requires an attached manuscript, dataset, bibliography, etc.

oneOf.description: Path to a fixture file, relative to the eval file's directory.

assertions.description: Machine-checkable expectations. At minimum every eval carries one should_trigger / should_not_trigger assertion declaring whether this skill should fire on the prompt.

type.description: should_trigger / should_not_trigger gate skill activation (value is boolean true). output_contains checks the response includes a substring/phrase (value is the string, case-insensitive by convention). behavior is a free-text rubric clause the LLM judge grades (value is the prose criterion).

value.description: Boolean true for should_trigger/should_not_trigger; a string for output_contains (the required substring) and behavior (the rubric clause).
